title: The Borrower's Closing Contact After Coming Home — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
The closing contact of a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is the check-in in which the primary borrower, back at home while the profile is still under monitoring, confirms in person on the handling date that occupancy has resumed. This entry governs the number of that closing contact. The monitoring it closes and the recording of the return remain as the product's rules on health-care absences provide.

## Check-ins during monitoring

During monitoring a check-in is made every interval between contacts set for the plan, counted in calendar days from the absence start date, and annual notices are suspended; the closing contact in which the borrower confirms in person having come home is numbered under this rule, a contact confirmed by an accepted facility letter and a check-in the borrower confirms in person while still in care are numbered under their own rules, and every other check-in is numbered by the count of check-ins of the current absence plus one.

## Who runs the tool

`confirm_return_home_701e433e` is a customer-side tool. The servicing agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the borrower who has come back home after a health-care stay — runs it to confirm in person, on that day, living in the home again.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `residency_profile_id` | reference number of the borrower's occupancy certification profile, as the servicing agent reads it out from the profile lookup | identifier |
| `checkin_sequence` | the check-in number the confirmation is recorded under on the profile, as the servicing agent states it | integer, 1-based, written without decimals |

## Effect

The confirmation is recorded as one check-in entry dated today in the profile's occupancy history, carrying the check-in number given, the profile's primary borrower and its loan program. The profile itself is not changed.

## Receipt

The borrower hears one line of the form "Return confirmed as check-in <entry reference> on profile <profile reference>: number <check-in number>, dated <today's date YYYY-MM-DD>." The entry reference is the new history entry's reference number; its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the check-in entry now exists, and the occupancy history lookup shows it.
